clips.caption: A person slides backward with their right leg while facing forward.
A person walks forward and then stands still, facing forward.

The woman in the green bounding box is performing yoga. She starts by bending her knees and lowering her body forward while extending her arms in front of her. As she rises, she opens her arms wider and stands tall with her hands reaching upwards. Her movements are fluid and graceful, reflecting a calm and focused demeanor.

The person in the green box is performing a dynamic exercise with a kettlebell. She starts by raising the kettlebell with her right hand while standing tall, then lifts her left knee to create a high march, switching her posture fluidly as her arms alternate movement. Her expressions show focus and energy, engaging actively in a training session likely in a gym setting.
A dancer raises their hands wide to the side and shuffles their right foot closer as they begin their dance routine.
A person stumbles forward while avoiding a car.
A person turns to their right and starts walking.
A person is slowly walking forward while swaying their arms back and forth.

A young man is performing a series of energetic jumps. He starts in a squatting position, then leaps into the air with arms outstretched and legs apart. After landing, he returns to the squat before jumping again. His movements are lively and dynamic, showcasing enthusiasm and fitness in an indoor setting.

The person is dancing energetically with raised arms. First, she lifts her arms up high, then brings them down to her sides with fluid motion. Next, she moves her arms in circular patterns, alternating between up and down. Her movements are smooth, expressing joy and enthusiasm.

A woman is exercising. She first raises her arms high above her head, then stretches them out to the sides while stepping from one foot to the other. She keeps her movements light and energetic, indicating she is focused and enjoying her workout in a bright indoor setting.
A person with an injured left leg slowly walks forward towards the diagonal left side while limping with short strides at a slow pace.
A person standing upright raises their left arm to their head in a salute.

A man is performing a dynamic exercise. He first lunges forward with one leg while pushing his arms forward. Then, he shifts his weight back as he brings his arms and leg back, followed by quickly lifting his knee and alternating his foot placement, showing energy and focus in a spacious indoor environment.

A young man in a white outfit is performing martial arts moves outdoors. He begins by shifting his weight to one leg, raising the other knee while extending his arms forward. He smoothly transitions to a sweeping motion with his arms, then brings them back while stepping forward, showcasing a fluid, confident style that suggests focus and control.

A woman is doing a dynamic exercise. She shifts her weight to one side, then steps forward while raising her arms in rhythm. Her legs move with energy, showcasing a strong, athletic build while her focused expression conveys determination. The movements are lively and reinforcing an upbeat atmosphere in an indoor setting.

A muscular young man is performing an overhead press exercise. He starts by holding dumbbells at shoulder height, then extends his arms upward fully before returning to the starting position. This motion showcases strength and control, and he appears determined and focused on his workout.

A man is walking and then starts to jog, moving his arms while shifting his weight from one leg to another. He appears focused as he energetically pushes forward, moving in a smooth motion that conveys an active and determined attitude.

A woman stands in a field, then she runs forward. She lifts her legs quickly, arms swing back and forth, showing energy. She briefly pauses, then continues with big strides, looking excited and playful as she enjoys the outdoors under gray skies.
A person with an injured right leg jogs towards the right diagonal.

A man is performing martial arts movements. He starts with a strong stance, then quickly shifts his body weight to the side while thrusting his arm forward, executing swift and precise strikes. His legs remain stable as his arms alternate between striking and guarding, showing focus and determination throughout the routine.

A young woman is dancing energetically. She moves her legs side to side while her arms wave in the air, creating an upbeat rhythm. As she shifts her weight back and forth, her body sways, showing a lively and playful attitude. The movements are smooth and confident, reflecting excitement.

The person is performing shuffle lunges. He begins by standing upright, then shifts his weight to one side while bending his knee and extending the other leg behind. He quickly switches sides, engaging his arms for balance and momentum, showing a dynamic and energetic style of movement typical of fitness routines.

A person stands still for a moment, then lifts one knee upward, simulating a high kick, while simultaneously pushing forward with their arms. This motion portrays strength and focus, possibly indicating they are practicing martial arts in a controlled indoor setting.
A person with an injured torso begins to walk forward slowly, their posture slightly hunched.

A woman is performing a squatting motion. First, she bends her knees and lowers her body while keeping her arms forward. Then, she lifts her arms above her head while straightening her legs. Finally, she returns to the starting squat position, showing strength and determination in her movements.

A young man is performing a badminton move. He starts with a wide stance, lunging forward and swinging his racket. As he moves, he steps back with his left foot, then pivots, adjusting his stance while raising his racket, displaying agility and focus in this indoor setting.

A woman in activewear performs a lively dance, starting with her arms raised and moving side to side while bending her knees. She then shifts her weight to one leg, extending the other leg while keeping her arms wide, demonstrating an energetic and cheerful style.

A young woman is performing an exercise. She begins by bending slightly forward, extending her arms out in front, then straightens her body while lifting her arms above her head, reaching upward. Each movement is controlled and precise, suggesting she is focused and determined.

The person is performing a happy dance. She starts by shifting her weight and moving her arms rhythmically from side to side. As she engages her feet, she begins to bounce slightly while maintaining a joyful expression. Her movements are light and fluid, showing excitement and a carefree attitude.
A person swears and waves their hands while frustratingly getting low to the ground.
The person turns over the right shoulder and starts to walk forward at a normal pace while holding a medium-heavy object.

A man is engaged in a training exercise. He starts with a low stance, bending his knees slightly while keeping his hands ready in front. As he moves, he shifts his weight between legs, lunging to the side while reaching out with one arm, indicating a defensive or evasive maneuver. His movements are quick and focused, reflecting a sporty demeanor in an outdoor setting.

A woman in bright clothing is performing a dance-like routine. She starts by swinging her arms widely while stepping side to side, then raises her arms above her head in a fluid motion, twirling her body gracefully, finally lowering her arms while returning to a stable position, appearing joyful and expressive.
A person effortlessly throws a ball with their left arm while the right arm hangs by the side.
A person performs a dance routine, extending their arms sideways and bringing them close to cross the hands in front of the chest in a crouched stance.
The person swiftly takes a jump forward with their right foot.

A woman is dancing energetically. She lifts her arms to the sides, then moves her hips and legs side to side in rhythm. As she moves, her feet shuffle slightly, and she occasionally spins, showcasing her lively movement style. The overall vibe feels joyful and spirited, set in an indoor environment.

A man is doing mountain climbers. He quickly raises his knees to his chest while keeping his arms bent at the elbows. He shifts his weight from one foot to the other, staying balanced and engaged, indicating an active and energetic workout style.

A woman is dancing energetically in an indoor setting. She raises her arms above her head, bends her elbows, and moves her body side to side, showcasing a lively and fun style. Her movements are rhythmic and confident, expressing a joyful attitude while dressed in a blue shirt and a white skirt.
A person is steadily walking sideways to the right in a crossover pattern while the arms are swaying by their sides.
A person standing upright raises their right arm to their head in a salute.
A person starts to walk with short strides steadily in the backward direction.

A woman is performing a fitness routine. She starts by standing with feet apart and arms raised in a punch position. Then, she shifts her weight to her right foot while throwing punches forward. Lastly, she resets to the starting position, showing energy and enthusiasm in her movements.

The person in the green box is walking forward while waving both hands upward. As they step, their knees bend slightly, adding a gentle bounce to their step. They keep a good rhythm with the others and appear cheerful, joining in the energetic group exercise.
